attributes.text:
Thank you for joining us at
Infra Energy Finance: USA 2026

Across the three streams at Infra Energy Finance in Dallas, the conversations kept returning to one question: where is capital going, and how do you act on it with confidence? Below is a recap of each stream, paired with Green Street insights to help inform your next move.

In Dallas, the conversation was about where capital is flowing across energy, and how geopolitical uncertainty, power and renewables, next-generation financing, private equity and LP appetite are shaping it. Green Street Infrastructure brings it into one place: exclusive news, comprehensive deal, fund and market data, live league tables, 69,000+ transactions tracked, and independent research across sectors — with the comparables to benchmark pricing and spot opportunities early so you can act with confidence at every stage of the investment cycle.

Digital infrastructure has gone from niche to core asset class, and the questions raised in Dallas show why: how to power it, how to finance it, and when to exit. Put the numbers behind the buildout, with Green Street’s Data Center Sector Update which covers hyperscaler spending, record leasing activity, supply constraints, and the debt markets funding it all. Download the report in case you missed it at our booth in Dallas.

Real opportunity or capital chasing headlines? It’s the question that ran through the Infrastructure sessions, from lender views on financing and construction risk to refinancing and consolidation. Green Street delivers independent research across ten key infrastructure sectors, including new Transport coverage of airports, toll roads, railroads and contractors. Download our Transport Infrastructure Sector Report to see how we frame a ~$1 trillion listed universe, from deal multiples to balance sheets.
